name: io.github.VelvetSP/web-retrieval-mcp
title: Web Retrieval MCP
description: Reliable web search, tiered page retrieval, research tools, provenance, caching, and SSRF guards.

environmentVariables.name: EXA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Exa API key for the default search and first fetch tier.

environmentVariables.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Firecrawl API key for fallback search/fetch and research tools.

environmentVariables.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Tavily key; Tavily calls also require the package's tavily extra.
